manifest_row.title: Why Trump's rollback of Obama rules won't do much for coal country

screening.main_topic: The likely effects of Trump’s rollback of Obama-era coal and power regulations on the U.S. coal industry and coal-producing regions.
screening.climate_relevance: The article discusses the rollback of the Clean Power Plan, identifying it as an effort to fight climate change by cutting power-sector carbon dioxide emissions. The climate policy debate is central to its account of the administration’s actions, even though the main focus is coal-industry prospects.
screening.reason: Climate change policy is a substantial part of the article’s subject: it examines the reversal of a major emissions-reduction policy and how that reversal may affect coal. The focus on economic outcomes does not make the climate-policy discussion incidental.
